mn67:16.8: This use of “we” in Pali is somewhat like the royal we in English. In this case, it indicates pride.
mn67:16.11: Following the Thai reading. Other editions add “and has returned to the lower life” in this and in all the parallel passages below.
mn67:17.6: Pali has different words to describe the act of eating different kinds of food: “To eat” is used for non-staple foods; “to consume,” for staple foods; and “to savor,” for delicacies such as sweets and desserts.
mn67:20.3: See also: SN 35:200; AN 5:114; Ud 3:3; Iti 109
